free_tier.stated: 5 GB free per account (shared with Yandex Mail attachments); paid 200 GB-2 TB from 319-699 RUB/mo
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Enforcement tightened in 2026: desktop sync became paid on 3 June 2026, over-quota disks are restricted after 44 days and files deleted 90 days after that; data loss risk is real for over-quota free accounts.

egress.terms: Free. Download links and public share URLs are unmetered, no per-GB egress line in the pricing.

tooling: rclone backend 'yandex' (rclone/rclone backend/yandex/yandex.go, in core); REST API at cloud-api.yandex.net/v1/disk; official REST docs
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited free Yandex accounts = 100 accounts for 500 GB. Weak per-identity yield, and 2026 policy tightening makes mass-account use the failure mode.
limits_note: monthly upload limit = 2x plan capacity (3x on Pro); free tier is now browser/mobile only
